content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need to map more than 64 parameters for VM mapping. Is it possible to add extra parameters to VM mapping? Thanks. Split from [company_name] [product_name] [article_no] - VM Mapping.
Welcome to the forum. Your question is quite general. Could you provide more details about your requirements and what exactly you’re trying to achieve?

Thank you for your attention to my message. I am using a [product_name] version 8, connected to an HMI device (from another manufacturer) which supports mapping 64 parameters. My issue is that I need a larger capacity, for example 80 parameters. Is it possible to expand the number of parameters if I use the appropriate software platform? I appreciate your attention to the attachment I have sent.

The maximum allowed parameters for VM mapping is 64 and cannot be increased. If you are transferring parameters from an analog multiplexer (for input/output to HMI), it is not possible to send more than 64 parameters to the HMI. Also, with the TIA software you cannot program [product_name]; you must use [product_name] software for this purpose.

analysis.insight_summary: A user has run into a system-imposed limitation of 64 parameters in VM mapping when trying to connect a controller to an HMI. The current product does not allow expanding this limit, preventing the user from mapping a larger set of parameters as needed.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to exceed the 64-parameter VM mapping restriction in order to accommodate a more complex HMI setup.
